name: Is AEO only for large accounting firms, or can small practices benefit too?

mainEntity.name: Is AEO only for large accounting firms, or can small practices benefit too?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO is beneficial for accounting firms of all sizes, including small practices. In fact, for smaller firms, AEO can be a powerful tool to compete with larger entities by enhancing local visibility and attracting clients who use AI-powered search for specific, often niche, services. It levels the playing field by focusing on precise content and structured data rather than solely on broad brand recognition. A well-executed AEO strategy can significantly boost a small practice's online presence and client acquisition.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO benefits accounting firms of all sizes, helping small practices compete by enhancing local visibility and attracting clients through precise content.
